# Start or resume RetailFlow work

Run the `start-session` skill. Inspect the real repository, Git status, branch, and HEAD. Read `doc/README.md`, `doc/10-open-items/Production-Gaps-and-Decision-Backlog.md`, and only the relevant `doc/` chapters and ADRs. Reconcile the documented snapshot with actual code and tests. Do not edit until you identify the active objective, scope, applicable IDs, unresolved decisions, and verification plan. Report any contradiction explicitly.
